title: Direct Delta writes from a Go service beside Spark on the same tables
summary: An electric-vehicle manufacturer replaced a dual-format, always-on Spark landing path for vehicle packet captures with an open-source Go connector writing straight to Delta tables under a DynamoDB-coordinated log store.
